jobs.name: AI SDLC Jira intake
jobs.prompt: Run one AI SDLC intake sweep. Call list_ready_jira_issues with lookback_minutes 10080 (7 days) so issues older than 20 minutes are included. For each issue returned, call create_job with exactly intake_event_id=<supplied intake_event_id>, jira_issue_key=<issue key>, and work_type=<supplied work type>. The create_job call is idempotent; if it returns an existing job, call get_job and resume only its recorded non-terminal state, never create another job or repeat completed transitions. For a new RECEIVED job, call get_effective_context with jira_issue_key=<issue key>. Before any prepare_workspace call, read context.repositories and call prepare_workspace with exactly {job_id:<job ID>, repository:<one context.repositories[].repository value>, execution_phase:"analyze"}; never omit repository or execution_phase and never invent either value. For implementation, call prepare_workspace again with exactly {job_id:<job ID>, repository:<the same routed repository>, execution_phase:"implement"}. If decision.can_plan is false or any conflict is blocking, record WAITING_INFORMATION with the exact reason, add a Jira comment, and stop on that issue. Otherwise follow ai-sdlc-execution through ANALYZING, PLANNING, implementation, every required quality gate, commit_and_push and create_pull_request. Never move new_module or new_project past planning without recorded human approval. Report the exact job ID and state per issue. If no issues are returned, do nothing and say so.

jobs.name: RPA daily report
jobs.prompt: Produce the RPA daily report. The period is the 24 hours ending at 09:00 Asia/Bangkok today: call query_rpa_metrics with from = yesterday 09:00 and to = today 09:00, both as ISO 8601 timestamps with the +07:00 offset. Render the result using the rpa-reporting skill's daily format. Send it with send_line_message using idempotency_key 'report:daily:<the from timestamp>' so a re-run cannot deliver a duplicate. Do not invent numbers: report exactly the counts and success_rate returned by the tool, and if every count is zero say that no runs were recorded.
